50 completed updates end before positive-time radiation at update 51 and patch respawn at update 250. Longer dynamics are not validated by this smoke test.

recommendation: The pipeline is ready for a modest follow-up, not a giant atlas. Keep 16 entries and fixed key 42, extend to 500 updates to exercise disturbances/patch respawn, then profile before increasing archive size. Current 16-entry CLIP evaluation already peaks near 5.7 GiB RSS.
